notes.title: Check the demo version of Iron Dungeon!
notes.notes:
I am pleased to announce that the updated demo version of my new game [b]Iron Dungeon[/b] is already available for review!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083910/Iron_Dungeon/

Iron Dungeon combines a twin stick shooter and a 2d platformer, seasoned with roguelike elements.

Buried under the ruins of civilization, the underground military complex has awakened, and resumed the production and training of combat clones.
Explore the premises of the complex in search of dozens of weapons and upgrades, fight enemies and pave your way to the surface to find out if there is still life on Earth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085504/e49509fc24f32e71065adab33bf38c1c9f197736.png[/img]

notes.title: Update v. 1.05
notes.notes:
- From now on, you can disable unnecessary blueprints forever (available after defeating the second boss). Despite this, you should have at least 20 implant blueprints and 6 weapon blueprints weapons.
- During the reroll, the price of the next attempt no longer increases. (this also applies to reroll weapon effect)
- Now you can see the progress of improvements (meta progression).
- Increased damage caused by explosions of your missiles, including electric ones.
- VCG is sold for nanoparticles, not cubes, as it was before.

Changes in updates 1.03 and 1.04:
- Improved performance.
- Fixed errors in the text.
- The cost of additional HP at the beginning of the run is significantly reduced.
- You no longer receive double damage in the second half of the run.
- The strength of the destroyed objects in the starting location is significantly reduced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085504/76d197c0627a6ac757b3b66792f1bc1c22254142.png[/img]

notes.title: Minor update v. 1.01/1.02
notes.notes:
I continue to work on improving the game! :)

- Now the implant can only be damaged if you run out of time or you have spent an extra life. (in boss fights, you can be calm)
- When pickup a new weapon, the bonus effect is not lost.
- Improved performance.

notes.title: Version 1.0 is available!
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!
I am glad to announce that version 1.0 is now available!
This means that the main work is finished and the REPLIKATOR has finally reached a full release.
For nine months in early access, the game has undergone significant changes and has become better thanks to everyone who shared feedback with me!

Some changes in the v. 1.0 update:
- Added secret rooms (look for special buttons on the walls).
- New challenge arenas. (you can get there through a portal that opens under certain conditions)
- Добавлена система дополнительных наград за прохождение уровней.
- The balance has been heavily redesigned.
- Added the final boss.
- The maximum number of implants has been increased to 15.
- Now, after activation of replication, there is a possibility of failure of the implant when receiving damage.
- During boss battles, the implant can also be damaged.
- Redesigned some implants and weapons, including VCG10000.
- Fixed a large number of bugs.
- Small visual improvements.
- Many other changes and improvements.
- Localization into Spanish. In the future, I hope to add other localizations.

The work continues.
I plan to release new updates in the future, including bug fixes, game balance improvements, and possibly adding new content.

notes.title: Update v. 0.983
notes.notes:
- Fixed many bugs and made changes to the game balance.
- Improved performance.
- Changes in some implants.
- CX-1 now has a new name - Bolt.
- Oreo now has a new name - Trigger.
- Bosses also have names.
- Sometimes your ship can be attacked. You will have to destroy all the enemies to advance further.
- Lina's ability has been reworked. Now she's calling a medical drone.
- The Bolt (CX-1) ability has also been reworked. Now he's launching homing missiles.
- The maximum possible invulnerability time of a Soldier has been reduced from 20 to 12 seconds.
- Enemy missiles now deal double damage on direct hit.
- Updated user interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085504/206d7518d698ac7365cc14d16e90d07049fd8b4e.png[/img]

notes.title: Update v. 0.982
notes.notes:
- Challenge arenas. When the station is dark, you can open a portal to the challenge arena. To do this, you need to destroy a sufficient number of enemies in a short time.
- You can now find gold-colored weapons. As a rule, the parameters of golden weapons are better, and it have a unique bonus that is not available to regular weapons.
- Now you can not use the shock wave while shooting.
- New enemy turrets.
- When using workbenches, the bonus effect of weapons will be replaced.
- Found item that improves the characteristics of a weapon NO replaces the bonus effect of the weapon.
- The limits for upgrading weapons with workbenches have been reduced, but you can still upgrade weapons with the items you find.
- By destroying the container with nanoparticles, there is a chance to get a battery.
- After the tenth rebirth, enemies stop generating items and nanoparticles.
- Small changes in the work of some implants and weapon bonuses.
- View mode does not work during boss battles.
- Now the full screen mode setting works correctly.
- Fix other bugs.
- Minor visual improvements.

notes.title: Update v. 0.981
notes.notes:
- Eight new implants available from the very start of the game. Some of the implants will allow you to open locked doors without using an access card.
- The chance of winning in the slot machine has been significantly increased.
- Each damaged implant increases your weapon damage by 10%.
- The increase in damage on the workbench has risen in price.
- The cost of extra life is reduced.
- Invisible (translucent) enemies are invulnerable.
- The behavior of some enemies is slightly changed.
- New music track on the main station/ship.
- A random music track plays during the battle.
- "Melee" has been renamed "Shock Wave".
- Bug fixes.

notes.title: Update v. 0.98
notes.notes:
- Now you can choose one of two modes in the main hub: ROGUELITE or TACTICS.
In the ROGUELITE mode, the descriptions of the implants are not visible until you pick them up (before that, only their titles are visible).
In TACTICS mode, everything is the same as before - the descriptions of the implants are always visible.
- The titles of some implants have been changed.
- Now the destruction of the items may be useful and justified.
- Some dialogues have been rewritten.
- Fixed a bug where implants were repaired even with insufficient nanoparticles.
- Fixed a bug where weapons were not improved using the workbench.
- Other minor fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085504/db4902732dec77e70d0a5142917c24b56a2fd00b.jpg[/img]

See you in the New Year!

notes.title: Update v. 0.979
notes.notes:
- Added the ability to destroy objects with melee attacks (weapons, implants, etc.).
- With the maximum health indicator, there is a small chance of getting a special aid kit. Such a aid kit replenishes the level of health above the maximum value.
- Implants "ADDITIONAL BATTERY", "UNIVERSAL KEY CARD", "FULL MAGAZINE" are now working again.
- Fixed a bug with an increasing price VCG10000.
- Now, when you die, you lose ammunition for VCG 10000.
- Small visual improvements.

notes.title: Update v. 0.978
notes.notes:
I think some of you have noticed that no new updates have been released recently. The fact is that working on the game takes a lot of time and effort, so I took a little vacation.
Now that I've had some rest, I'm going back to developing.

This small update mainly includes bug fixes and performance improvements on weak computers.

- Fixed incorrect display of markers on the map.
- Now, when you run the game on a laptop, a discrete video adapter is selected. (IAnyway I hope so)*
- Performance optimization.
- Buying a level map now requires one battery instead of two.


*If the game slows down on a laptop with a discrete video card, then you need to go to the video card settings and manually set the game to start using a discrete video adapter.
(Nvidia Control Panel or Catalyst Control Center)

notes.title: Update v. 0.977
notes.notes:
UPD!
Now the implants fail only when you lose an extra life (1UP).
The cost of an extra life is slightly reduced. 
Now you can buy up to three 1UP, or find up to five 1UP at stations.

[strike]Now, when you take damage, one of your implants may fail.[/strike]

FAULTY implants have negative consequences, as a rule - the opposite of the positive effect of SERVICEABLE implants.

On the ship you will find a workbench where you can repair all the implants.

Among other changes:
- Fixed minor bugs.
- Small graphic changes.
- Small changes in the balance.

notes.title: Update v. 0.976
notes.notes:
- The saving system has been completely redesigned. From now on, when you exit the game during the run, all progress will be saved.
- Added a terminal where you can read the found entries (so far only 11 entries can be found). 
- Entries on the levels are displayed in the view mode.
- The "RAGE" implant has been redesigned. From now on, after taking damage, you deal increased damage for three seconds.
- The "DOME" implant has been redesigned. From now on, when using the dome, you can shoot.
- In the game settings, you can fix the camera over the character.
- Now, when using the workbench, the bonus effect of the weapon is replaced randomly.
- Added a new item that improves one of the characteristics of the weapon for free.
- Bugs fixes.

notes.title: Update v. 0.975
notes.notes:
Once again, I want to thank everyone who shares their impressions, gives feedback and contributes in every possible way to the development of the project, as well as all those who bought the game and, I hope, had a good time in it!


- Now the weapon that you find has one of two dozen unique properties.
Thanks to this, the variability of various weapons has become even higher.
- Occasionally, at the initial levels, you will meet stronger enemies from later levels.
- When using 1UP, the health of bosses is not restored.
- When using 1UP, the ammunition of the current weapon is replenished.
- Fixed a bug that led to the removal of all markers from the map.
- Fixed bugs in the main menu.
- Minor changes in the interface.

notes.title: Update v. 0.974
notes.notes:
- The system of danger levels has been completely redesigned. From now on, only the first boss is available to you at the first danger level, at the second danger level you can reach the second boss, etc.
- You are guaranteed to get a blueprints and several cubes from each boss.
- At the stations, you can find up to three blueprints at a time.

notes.title: Update v. 0.973
notes.notes:
- Two new enemies (Danger Level 3+)
- A new enemy turret that will force you to reconsider your battle tactics (Danger Level 4+)
- New attacks for bosses depending on the danger level.
- Screen shaking during rocket explosions is significantly reduced.
- Optimization for better performance.
- With each rebirth of enemies, their health reserve increases.
- Small changes in some types of weapons.
- Bug fixes.
- Minor changes in the interface.

notes.title: Update v. 0.972
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug that led to the disappearance of weapon blueprints!!!

- Increased reward for killing enemies. (danger level 2+)
- The nanoparticle container now contains more nanoparticles. (danger level 2+)
- The spikes are triggered a little earlier.
- The "rage" implant now triples the damage caused by the weapon.
- Some minor fixes.

notes.title: Update v. 0.971
notes.notes:
- ːsteamhappyːThe viewing mode has almost completely turned into a map. Now you will see everything!
- Ammunition and aid kits drop out less often as you progress.
- In addition to the floor spikes, wall spikes have also now appeared. (danger level 2+)
- The "Vampirism" implant works a little less often.
- The accumulation of nanoparticles when killing enemies is now visualized.
- Minor graphical improvements.
- Bug fixes.

notes.title: Update v. 0.97
notes.notes:
- The workbench system has been completely redesigned, now it is more logical.
- The zoom percentage and the scrolling distance in the viewing mode have been increased.
- Increased the starting number of enemies.
- The spawn speed of enemies depends on the level of danger.
- Fixed a bug with the slot machine.
- Now you can win melee upgrades in the slot machine.
- The number of dropped ammunition and first-aid kits is slightly reduced.
- Item that gives +1 to maximum health is now less common.
- 50 deaths are now enough to get the "veteran" achievement.

notes.title: Update v. 0.969
notes.notes:
- In the viewing mode, you can now see the zones that you have visited.
- When killing a mini-boss, there is a chance to get a blueprint.
- Fixed a bug that leads to the appearance of two identical implants.
- Increased the chance of a terminal with a map spawning.
- The cost of disabling blueprints does not increase.
- Bug fixes.

notes.title: Update v.0.968
notes.notes:
- Special ammunition is needed to use the VCG10000
- Now you can disable some of the blueprints (danger level 3)
- The hub ship has been completely redesigned
- Now it is enough to hold down the melee button to attack
- The "1" and "2" keys can be used to change weapons
- Only ammunition for your weapons drops out of bosses during the battle
- The speed of operation of the spikes depends on the level of danger (DL)
- Correction of errors and typos in the text
- Bug fixes

notes.title: Demo updated to version 0.965
notes.notes:
- Added new markers in the view mode.
- Added a pointer arrow that indicates the path to the terminal (if you found the terminal map).
- Now the current immunity is displayed under the character icon.
- The treatment terminal now restores no more than 3 health points.
- Completely redesigned melee attack.
- Dropped ammo restores a percentage of the maximum ammo.
- Work on the balance of weapons.
- The triple lasergun has been replaced with a new unique weapon (previous update).
- The number of items that you can find has been increased.
- Reduced reward for killing enemies.
- Small visual improvements.
- Bug fixes.

notes.title: Update v.0.95/v.0.96
notes.notes:
- Now the game has a procedural generation of levels!
- A portion of all enemies now appear only when entering a room.
- Found weapons can now be upgraded on your ship (To do this, you will need to activate the workbenches in the main station).
- Before starting a new run, in addition to the second weapon, you can also take one free UPGRADE.
- Stations on the level selection map are divided by difficulty.
- Bug fixes.
